issue.description:
ADR-005 (Accepted) specifies an advisory `ready_frontier` check in `doctor` under the `dependencies` scope: warn when open issues carry an assignee, name a bounded sample of the offending ids, and state the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`). This is the state that left 583 beads unclaimable across 47 workspaces in the 2026-08-16 sweep while `doctor` reported every workspace healthy, and environment docs still describe it as silent — yet no open bead implements the check. Work: first confirm against live `bead doctor` output that the warning is genuinely absent (avoid duplicating closed work), then implement the check with tests covering the open+assigned warning case, in_progress/released cases that must not warn, and the hard rule that `doctor` never clears an assignee, not even under `--repair`.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add doctor ready_frontier check warning on open issues that carry an assignee (ADR-005)

issue.description: Proposal, not yet admitted by the operator. Once the ruleset 4 binary is installed, every stored credential it detects has a fingerprint, so bead redact can destroy it. Per workspace: confirm the credential was rotated; run bead redact --finding for each fingerprint with an actor and a reason, remembering that every stored copy is a separate finding (live rows, event details, and both retained generations); verify that doctor reports no unacknowledged blocking finding and that a sanitized generation set was published; record the receipts. Redaction does not clean history that was already pushed: rotation is the remedy, and any history rewrite is a separate operator decision. Blocked by BR-T44.
issue.title: Redact pre-ruleset-4 findings from fleet bead stores after rotation (BR-T45)
